sections.label: Book 20
sections.name: The Sautramani continued: the Sacrificer's blessing

verses.sa: क्षत्रस्य योनिरसि क्षत्रस्य नाभिरसि। मा त्वा हिंसीन्मा मा हिंसीः॥
verses.tr: kṣatrasya yonirasi kṣatrasya nābhirasi mā tvā hiṃsīnmā mā hiṃsīḥ
verses.en: Birth of princely power art thou: centre art thou of princely power. Harm not thyself: do me no harm.

verses.sa: नि षसाद घृतव्रतो वरुणः पस्त्यास्वा। साम्राज्याय सुक्रतुः। मृत्योः पाहि विद्योत्पाहि॥
verses.tr: ni ṣasāda ghṛtavrato varuṇaḥ pastyāsvā sāmrājyāya sukratuḥ mṛtyoḥ pāhi vidyotpāhi
verses.en: Varuna, Law's maintainer, hath sat down, etc., as in X. Save me from death. Save me from lightning.

verses.sa: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवेऽश्विनोर्बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्याम्। अश्विनोर्भैषज्येन तेजसे ब्रह्मवर्चसायाभि षिञ्चामि सरस्वत्यै भैषज्येन वीर्यायान्नाद्यायाभि षिञ्चामीन्द्रस्येन्द्रियेण बलाय श्रियै यशसेऽभि षिञ्चामि॥
verses.tr: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām aśvinorbhaiṣajyena tejase brahmavarcasāyābhi ṣiñcāmi sarasvatyai bhaiṣajyena vīryāyānnādyāyābhi ṣiñcāmīndrasyendriyeṇa balāya śriyai yaśase'bhi ṣiñcāmi
verses.en: Thee, by the radiant Savitar's impulsion, with arms of Alvins, with the hands of PAshan, With leech-craft of the Asviiis, I besprinkle for splendour, for the tiie lustre of a Brahman; With leech-craft of Sarasvati, besprinkle for manly vigour and for food to feed thee; Besprinkle thee, by special power of Indra, for strength of body and for fame and glory.

verses.sa: कोऽसि कतमोऽसि कस्मै त्वा काय त्वा। सुश्लोक सुमङ्गल सत्यराजन्॥
verses.tr: ko'si katamo'si kasmai tvā kāya tvā suśloka sumaṅgala satyarājan
verses.en: Thou art Ka. Noblest Ka art thou. Thee for the state and rank of Ka. Sumangala! I Susoma! Satyarajan!

verses.sa: शिरो मे श्रीर्यशो मुखं त्विषिः केशाश्च श्मश्रूणि। राजा मे प्राणो अमृतं सम्राट् चक्षुर्विराट् श्रोत्रम्॥
verses.tr: śiro me śrīryaśo mukhaṃ tviṣiḥ keśāśca śmaśrūṇi rājā me prāṇo amṛtaṃ samrāṭ cakṣurvirāṭ śrotram
verses.en: My head be grace, my mouth be fame, my hair and beard be brilliant sheen! My breath be King and deathlessness, mine eye Sole Lord, mine ear the Prince!

verses.sa: जिह्वा मे भद्रं वाङ्महो मनो मन्युः स्वराड् भामः। मोदाः प्रमोदा अङ्गुलीरङ्गानि मित्रं मे सहः॥
verses.tr: jihvā me bhadraṃ vāṅmaho mano manyuḥ svarāḍ bhāmaḥ modāḥ pramodā aṅgulīraṅgāni mitraṃ me sahaḥ
verses.en: My tongue be bliss, my voice be might, my mind be wrath, my rage self-lord! Joys be my fingers, and delight my members, conquering strength my friend!

verses.sa: बाहू मे बलमिन्द्रियं हस्तौ मे कर्म वीर्यम्। आत्मा क्षत्रमुरो मम॥
verses.tr: bāhū me balamindriyaṃ hastau me karma vīryam ātmā kṣatramuro mama
verses.en: Let my two arms be Indra's power, my mj hands be deed of manly might, my soul and breast be princely rule!

verses.sa: पृष्ठीर्मे राष्ट्रमुदरमंसौ ग्रीवाश्च श्रोणी। ऊरू अरत्नी जानुनी विशो मेऽङ्गानि सर्वतः॥
verses.tr: pṛṣṭhīrme rāṣṭramudaramaṃsau grīvāśca śroṇī ūrū aratnī jānunī viśo me'ṅgāni sarvataḥ
verses.en: My ribs be royal government, my belly, shoulders, neck, and hips, Thighs, elbows, knees, the people, yea, my members universally!

verses.sa: नाभिर्मे चित्तं विज्ञानं पायुर्मेऽपचितिर्भसत्। आनन्दनन्दावाण्डौ मे भगः सौभाग्यं पसः। जङ्घाभ्यां पद्भ्यां धर्मोऽस्मि विशि राजा प्रतिष्ठितः॥
verses.tr: nābhirme cittaṃ vijñānaṃ pāyurme'pacitirbhasat ānandanandāvāṇḍau me bhagaḥ saubhāgyaṃ pasaḥ jaṅghābhyāṃ padbhyāṃ dharmo'smi viśi rājā pratiṣṭhitaḥ
verses.en: My navel intellect, etc., et/C. Duty am I in legs and feet, established King among the folk.

verses.sa: प्रति क्षत्रे प्रति तिष्ठामि राष्ट्रे प्रत्यश्वेषु प्रति तिष्ठामि गोषु। प्रत्यङ्गेषु प्रति तिष्ठाम्यात्मन् प्रति प्राणेषु प्रति तिष्ठामि पुष्टे प्रति द्यावापृथिव्योः प्रति तिष्ठामि यज्ञे॥
verses.tr: prati kṣatre prati tiṣṭhāmi rāṣṭre pratyaśveṣu prati tiṣṭhāmi goṣu pratyaṅgeṣu prati tiṣṭhāmyātman prati prāṇeṣu prati tiṣṭhāmi puṣṭe prati dyāvāpṛthivyoḥ prati tiṣṭhāmi yajñe
verses.en: I take my stand on princely power and Kingship, on cows am I dependent, and on horses. On members I depend, and on the body, on vital breath dependent and on welfare, on heaven and earth and sacrifice dependent.

verses.sa: त्रया देवा एकादश त्रयस्त्रिंशाः सुराधसः। बृहस्पतिपुरोहिता देवस्य सवितुः सवे। देवा देवैरवन्तु मा॥
verses.tr: trayā devā ekādaśa trayastriṃśāḥ surādhasaḥ bṛhaspatipurohitā devasya savituḥ save devā devairavantu mā
verses.en: May Deities, eleven threes, the three and thirty bounteous Ones. Whose house priest is Brihaspati, by impulse of bright Savitar, the Gods protect me with the Gods.

verses.sa: प्रथमा द्वितीयैर्द्वितीयास्तृतीयैस्तृतीयाः सत्येन सत्यं यज्ञेन यज्ञो यजुर्भिर्यजूंषि सामभिः सामान्यृग्भिरृचः पुरोऽनुवाक्याभिः पुरोऽनुवाक्या याज्याभिर्याज्या वषट्कारैर्वषट्कारा आहुतिभिराहुतयो मे कामान्त्समर्धयन्तु भूः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: prathamā dvitīyairdvitīyāstṛtīyaistṛtīyāḥ satyena satyaṃ yajñena yajño yajurbhiryajūṃṣi sāmabhiḥ sāmānyṛgbhirṛcaḥ puro'nuvākyābhiḥ puro'nuvākyā yājyābhiryājyā vaṣaṭkārairvaṣaṭkārā āhutibhirāhutayo me kāmāntsamardhayantu bhūḥ svāhā
verses.en: May the (first Gods with the second, the second with the third, the third with the Truth, Truth with Sacrifice, Sacrifice with sacrificial texts, sacrificial texts with Samans, Samans with praise-verses, praise-verses with fore and after-sentences, fore sentences with inviting?- texts, inviting-texts with Vashat-calls, Vashat-calls with oblations, and oblations, fulfil my desires, Earth! All-hail!

verses.sa: लोमानि प्रयतिर्मम त्वङ्म आनतिरागतिः। मांसं म उपनतिर्वस्वस्थि मज्जा म आनतिः॥
verses.tr: lomāni prayatirmama tvaṅma ānatirāgatiḥ māṃsaṃ ma upanatirvasvasthi majjā ma ānatiḥ
verses.en: My hair is effort and attempt, my skin is reverence and approach. My flesh is inclination, wealth my bone, my marrow reverence. I

verses.sa: यद्देवा देवहेडनं देवासश्चकृमा वयम्। अग्निर्मा तस्मादेनसो विश्वान्मुञ्चत्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: yaddevā devaheḍanaṃ devāsaścakṛmā vayam agnirmā tasmādenaso viśvānmuñcatvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Gods. Deities, whatever fault of ours have stirred the wrath of Gods, May Agni set me free from that iniquity and all distress.

verses.sa: यदि दिवा यदि नक्तमेनांसि चकृमा वयम्। वायुर्मा तस्मादेनसो विश्वान्मुञ्चत्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: yadi divā yadi naktamenāṃsi cakṛmā vayam vāyurmā tasmādenaso viśvānmuñcatvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: If in the day-time or at night we have committed acts of sin, May Vayu set me free from that iniquity and all distress.

verses.sa: यदि जाग्रद्यदि स्वप्न एनांसि चकृमा वयम्। सूर्यो मा तस्मादेनसो विश्वान्मुञ्चत्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: yadi jāgradyadi svapna enāṃsi cakṛmā vayam sūryo mā tasmādenaso viśvānmuñcatvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: If when awake or in our sleep we have committed acts of sin, May SArya set me free from that iniquity and all distress.

verses.sa: यद्ग्रामे यदरण्ये यत्सभायां यदिन्द्रिये। यच्छूद्रे यदर्ये यदेनश्चकृमा वयं यदेकस्याधि धर्मणि तस्यावयजनमसि॥
verses.tr: yadgrāme yadaraṇye yatsabhāyāṃ yadindriye yacchūdre yadarye yadenaścakṛmā vayaṃ yadekasyādhi dharmaṇi tasyāvayajanamasi
verses.en: Each r<ault in village or in wild, company or corporeal sense, Each sinful act that we have done to $Sdra or Arya, or to either's disadvantage, e'en of that sin thou art the expiation.

verses.sa: यदापो अघ्न्या इति वरुणेति शपामहे ततो वरुण नो मुञ्च। अवभृथ निचुम्पुण निचेरुरसि निचुम्पुणः। अव देवैर्देवकृतमेनोऽयक्ष्यव मर्त्यैर्मर्त्यकृतं पुरुराव्णो देव रिषस्पाहि॥
verses.tr: yadāpo aghnyā iti varuṇeti śapāmahe tato varuṇa no muñca avabhṛtha nicumpuṇa nicerurasi nicumpuṇaḥ ava devairdevakṛtameno'yakṣyava martyairmartyakṛtaṃ pururāvṇo deva riṣaspāhi
verses.en: Waters, Inviolable ones, etc. Said to be repeated from O ever-moving Cleansing Bath, etc. Repeated from III.

verses.sa: समुद्रे ते हृदयमप्स्वन्तः सं त्वा विशन्त्वोषधीरुतापः। सुमित्रिया न आप ओषधयः सन्तु दुर्मित्रियास्तस्मै सन्तु योऽस्मान्द्वेष्टि यं च वयं द्विष्मः॥
verses.tr: samudre te hṛdayamapsvantaḥ saṃ tvā viśantvoṣadhīrutāpaḥ sumitriyā na āpa oṣadhayaḥ santu durmitriyāstasmai santu yo'smāndveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ
verses.en: Thy heart is in the flood, etc. Repeated from VIII. To us let Waters, etc. Repeated from VI.

verses.sa: द्रुपदादिव मुमुचानः स्विन्नः स्नातो मलादिव। पूतं पवित्रेणेवाज्यमापः शुन्धन्तु मैनसः॥
verses.tr: drupadādiva mumucānaḥ svinnaḥ snāto malādiva pūtaṃ pavitreṇevājyamāpaḥ śundhantu mainasaḥ
verses.en: As one unfastened from a stake, or cleansed by bathing after toil, As butter which the sieve hath purged, let water clean me from my sin.

verses.sa: उद्वयं तमसस्परि स्वः पश्यन्त उत्तरम्। देवं देवत्रा सूर्यमगन्म ज्योतिरुत्तमम्॥
verses.tr: udvayaṃ tamasaspari svaḥ paśyanta uttaram devaṃ devatrā sūryamaganma jyotiruttamam
verses.en: Looking upon the loftier light above the darkness we have come To Silrya, God among the Gods, the light that is most ex excellent.

verses.sa: अपो अद्यान्वचारिषं रसेन समसृक्ष्महि। पयस्वानग्न आऽगमं तं मा सं सृज वर्चसा प्रजया च धनेन च॥
verses.tr: apo adyānvacāriṣaṃ rasena samasṛkṣmahi payasvānagna ā'gamaṃ taṃ mā saṃ sṛja varcasā prajayā ca dhanena ca
verses.en: The waters I this day have sought, and to their essence have we come. Agai, come hither rich in milk, splendour and brilliancy bestow on me, and progeny and wealth.

verses.sa: एधोऽस्येधिषीमहि समिदसि तेजोऽसि तेजो मयि धेहि। समाववर्ति पृथिवी समुषाः समु सूर्यः। समु विश्वमिदं जगत्। वैश्वानरज्योतिर्भूयासं विभून् कामान् व्यश्नवै भूः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: edho'syedhiṣīmahi samidasi tejo'si tejo mayi dhehi samāvavarti pṛthivī samuṣāḥ samu sūryaḥ samu viśvamidaṃ jagat vaiśvānarajyotirbhūyāsaṃ vibhūn kāmān vyaśnavai bhūḥ svāhā
verses.en: A brand art thou: fain would we thrive. Fuel art thou and splendour: give me splendour. Earth comes again, the Dawn, the Sun. This Universe all comes again. May I possess Vaisvanara's light, may I attain my vast desires. Earth! All-hail!

verses.sa: अभ्या दधामि समिधमग्ने व्रतपते त्वयि। व्रतं च श्रद्धां चोपैमीन्धे त्वा दीक्षितो अहम्॥
verses.tr: abhyā dadhāmi samidhamagne vratapate tvayi vrataṃ ca śraddhāṃ copaimīndhe tvā dīkṣito aham
verses.en: O Agni, Master of the Vow, on thee I lay the kindling-stick. To the fast-vow and faith I come. I, consecrated, kindle thee.

verses.sa: यत्र ब्रह्म च क्षत्रं च सम्यञ्चो चरतः सह। तँल्लोकं पुण्यं प्रज्ञेषं यत्र देवाः सहाग्निना॥
verses.tr: yatra brahma ca kṣatraṃ ca samyañco carataḥ saha taṃllokaṃ puṇyaṃ prajñeṣaṃ yatra devāḥ sahāgninā
verses.en: Fain would I know that holy world where Deities with Agni dwell, Where priestly rank and princely power together in accordance move.

verses.sa: यत्रेन्द्रश्च वायुश्च सम्यञ्चो चरतः सह। तँल्लोकं पुण्यं प्रज्ञेषं यत्र सेदिर्न विद्यते॥
verses.tr: yatrendraśca vāyuśca samyañco carataḥ saha taṃllokaṃ puṇyaṃ prajñeṣaṃ yatra sedirna vidyate
verses.en: Fain would I know 'that holy world where want and languor are unknown, Where in complete accordance move Indra and VAyu side by side.

verses.sa: अंशुना ते अंशुः पृच्यतां परुषा परुः। गन्धस्ते सोममवतु मदाय रसो अच्युतः॥
verses.tr: aṃśunā te aṃśuḥ pṛcyatāṃ paruṣā paruḥ gandhaste somamavatu madāya raso acyutaḥ
verses.en: Let thy shoot be united! with his tendril, joint combine with joint. Imperishable sap for joy, thine odour be the Soma's guard!

verses.sa: सिञ्चन्ति परि षिञ्चन्त्युत्सिञ्चन्ति पुनन्ति च। सुरायै बभ्र्वै मदे किन्त्वो वदति किन्त्वः॥
verses.tr: siñcanti pari ṣiñcantyutsiñcanti punanti ca surāyai babhrvai made kintvo vadati kintvaḥ
verses.en: They pour it out, they sprinkle it, they scatter it, they make it pure. In the brown Sm&'s ecstasy he says What art thou? What art thou?

verses.sa: धानावन्तं करम्भिणमपूपवन्तमुक्थिनम्। इन्द्र प्रातर्जुषस्व नः॥
verses.tr: dhānāvantaṃ karambhiṇamapūpavantamukthinam indra prātarjuṣasva naḥ
verses.en: Indra, at morn accept our cake accompanied with grain and groats, with wheaten bread and hymns of praise.

verses.sa: बृहदिन्द्राय गायत मरुतो वृत्रहन्तमम्। येन ज्योतिरजनयन्नृतावृधो देवं देवाय जागृवि॥
verses.tr: bṛhadindrāya gāyata maruto vṛtrahantamam yena jyotirajanayannṛtāvṛdho devaṃ devāya jāgṛvi
verses.en: To Indra sing the lofty hymn, Maruts I that slayeth Vritra best, Whereby the Holy Ones created for the God the radiant light that never dies.

verses.sa: अध्वर्यो अद्रिभिः सुतं सोमं पवित्र आ नय। पुनाहीन्द्राय पातवे॥
verses.tr: adhvaryo adribhiḥ sutaṃ somaṃ pavitra ā naya punāhīndrāya pātave
verses.en: Adhvaryu, on the straining-cloth pour thou the Soma pressed with stones: Purify it for Indra's. drink.

verses.sa: यो भूतानामधिपतिर्यस्मिँल्लोका अधि श्रिताः। य ईशे महतो महाँस्तेन गृह्णामि त्वामहं मयि गृह्णामि त्वामहम्॥
verses.tr: yo bhūtānāmadhipatiryasmiṃllokā adhi śritāḥ ya īśe mahato mahāṃstena gṛhṇāmi tvāmahaṃ mayi gṛhṇāmi tvāmaham
verses.en: The Sovran Lord of living things, he upon whom the worlds depend, Mighty, the mighty's King—-by him I take thee, take thee on myself.

verses.sa: उपयामगृहीतोऽस्यश्विभ्यां त्वा सरस्वत्यै त्वेन्द्राय त्वा सुत्राम्ण एष ते योनिरश्विभ्यां त्वा सरस्वत्यै त्वेन्द्राय त्वा सुत्राम्णे॥
verses.tr: upayāmagṛhīto'syaśvibhyāṃ tvā sarasvatyai tvendrāya tvā sutrāmṇa eṣa te yoniraśvibhyāṃ tvā sarasvatyai tvendrāya tvā sutrāmṇe
verses.en: Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for the Asvins. T his is thy home, etc.

verses.sa: प्राणपा मे अपानपाश्चक्षुष्पाः श्रोत्रपाश्च मे। वाचो मे विश्वभेषजो मनसोऽसि विलायकः॥
verses.tr: prāṇapā me apānapāścakṣuṣpāḥ śrotrapāśca me vāco me viśvabheṣajo manaso'si vilāyakaḥ
verses.en: Guard of my breath and outward breath, the guardian of mine eye and ear, Ali-healer of my voice, thou art the mollifier of my mind.

verses.sa: अश्विनकृतस्य ते सरस्वतिकृतस्येन्द्रेण सुत्राम्णा कृतस्य। उपहूत उपहूतस्य भक्षयामि॥
verses.tr: aśvinakṛtasya te sarasvatikṛtasyendreṇa sutrāmṇā kṛtasya upahūta upahūtasya bhakṣayāmi
verses.en: Invited I feed upon thee invited, Whom Asvirra, whom- Sarasvati, whom Indra,. Good Protector, made.

verses.sa: समिद्ध इन्द्र उषसामनीके पुरोरुचा पूर्वकृद्वावृधानः। त्रिभिर्देवैस्त्रिंशता वज्रबाहुर्जघान वृत्रं वि दुरो ववार॥
verses.tr: samiddha indra uṣasāmanīke purorucā pūrvakṛdvāvṛdhānaḥ tribhirdevaistriṃśatā vajrabāhurjaghāna vṛtraṃ vi duro vavāra
verses.en: Kindled in forefront of the Mornings, Indra with, forward. light, long-active, waxing mighty, With three and thirty Gods, the- Thunder, smote Vritra dead and threw the portals open.

verses.sa: नराशंसः प्रति शूरो मिमानस्तनूनपात्प्रति यज्ञस्य धाम। गोभिर्वपावान् मधुना समञ्जन् हिरण्यैश्चन्द्री यजति प्रचेताः॥
verses.tr: narāśaṃsaḥ prati śūro mimānastanūnapātprati yajñasya dhāma gobhirvapāvān madhunā samañjan hiraṇyaiścandrī yajati pracetāḥ
verses.en: Son of Himself, the Praise of Men, the Hero, measuring out the sacrificial stations, Rich in bulls' fat,, anointing with sweet butter, wise, bright with gauds of gold, he sacrificeth.

verses.sa: ईडितो देवैर्हरिवाँ२ अभिष्टिराजुह्वानो हविषा शर्धमानः। पुरन्दरो गोतभिद्वज्रबाहुरा यातु यज्ञमुप नो जुषाणः॥
verses.tr: īḍito devairharivāṃ2 abhiṣṭirājuhvāno haviṣā śardhamānaḥ purandaro gotabhidvajrabāhurā yātu yajñamupa no juṣāṇaḥ
verses.en: Lauded by Gods, Lord of Bay Steeds, the Helper, showing his& greatness; worshipped with oblations; ¥Fort-render, Cowpen-cleaver, Thunder-wielder,. may he ap approach our sacrifice' rejoicing.

verses.sa: जुषाणो बर्हिर्हरिवान् न इन्द्रः प्राचीनं सीदत् प्रदिशा पृथिव्याः। उरुप्रथाः प्रथमानं स्योनमादित्यैरक्तं वसुभिः सजोषाः॥
verses.tr: juṣāṇo barhirharivān na indraḥ prācīnaṃ sīdat pradiśā pṛthivyāḥ uruprathāḥ prathamānaṃ syonamādityairaktaṃ vasubhiḥ sajoṣāḥ
verses.en: May Indra, Lord of, Bays, sit by direction eastward on oil earth accepting our oblation, And sacred grass, fair, far-spread, widely-stretching, anointed by Adityas and by Vasus.

verses.sa: इन्द्रं दुरः कवष्यो धावमाना वृषाणं यन्तु जनयः सुपत्नीः। द्वारो देवीरभितो वि श्रयन्तां सुवीरा वीरं प्रथमाना महोभिः॥
verses.tr: indraṃ duraḥ kavaṣyo dhāvamānā vṛṣāṇaṃ yantu janayaḥ supatnīḥ dvāro devīrabhito vi śrayantāṃ suvīrā vīraṃ prathamānā mahobhiḥ
verses.en: To the strong Indra go the sounding Portals, dames with a at good-ly husband', swiftly moving!: Well-manned, divine, wide be the Doors< thrown (^open, expanding in their greatness for the Hero! I

verses.sa: उषासानक्ता बृहती बृहन्तं पयस्वती सुदुघे शूरमिन्द्रम्। तन्तुं ततं पेशसा संवयन्ती देवानां देवं यजतः सुरुक्मे॥
verses.tr: uṣāsānaktā bṛhatī bṛhantaṃ payasvatī sudughe śūramindram tantuṃ tataṃ peśasā saṃvayantī devānāṃ devaṃ yajataḥ surukme
verses.en: Dawn and Night, lofty, richly, -fair-showing, as they weave with varied colour The long-extended thread in co' concert, worship the God of Gods, the lofty Hero Indra.

verses.sa: दैव्या मिमाना मनुषः पुरुत्रा होताराविन्द्रं प्रथमा सुवाचा। मूर्धन् यज्ञस्य मधुना दधाना प्राचीनं ज्योतिर्हविषा वृधातः॥
verses.tr: daivyā mimānā manuṣaḥ purutrā hotārāvindraṃ prathamā suvācā mūrdhan yajñasya madhunā dadhānā prācīnaṃ jyotirhaviṣā vṛdhātaḥ
verses.en: The two first pleasant-voiced celestial il Hotars, arranging rites for man in sundry places. At head of sacrifice stahlishing Indra, increase the eastern light with sweet oblation.

verses.sa: तिस्रो देवीर्हविषा वर्धमाना इन्द्रं जुषाणा जनयो न पत्नीः। अच्छिन्नं तन्तुं पयसा सरस्वतीडा देवी भारती विश्वतूर्तिः॥
verses.tr: tisro devīrhaviṣā vardhamānā indraṃ juṣāṇā janayo na patnīḥ acchinnaṃ tantuṃ payasā sarasvatīḍā devī bhāratī viśvatūrtiḥ
verses.en: Thriving by sacrifice may the three Bright Ones, taking delight like wedded dames in Indra, Id\, B i^i'ati all-surpassing, with milk preserve our sacred thread unbroken.

verses.sa: त्वष्टा दधच्छुष्ममिन्द्राय वृष्णेऽपाकोऽचिष्टुर्यशसे पुरूणि। वृषा यजन्वृषणं भूरिरेता मूर्धन् यज्ञस्य समनक्तु देवान्॥
verses.tr: tvaṣṭā dadhacchuṣmamindrāya vṛṣṇe'pāko'ciṣṭuryaśase purūṇi vṛṣā yajanvṛṣaṇaṃ bhūriretā mūrdhan yajñasya samanaktu devān
verses.en: M May Tvashtar coming from afar, the active, give-, strength and plenty to strong< glorious Indra,. And strong, prolific, worshipping, the Mighty at sacrifice's head give the Gods honour.

verses.sa: वनस्पतिरवसृष्टो न पाशैस्त्मन्या समञ्जञ्छमिता न देवः। इन्द्रस्य हव्यैर्जठरं पृणानः स्वदाति यज्ञं मधुना घृतेन॥
verses.tr: vanaspatiravasṛṣṭo na pāśaistmanyā samañjañchamitā na devaḥ indrasya havyairjaṭharaṃ pṛṇānaḥ svadāti yajñaṃ madhunā ghṛtena
verses.en: Let the 'divine Stake, like an Immolator, bind, as one ordered, to himself the victim, And, filling Indra's belly with oblations, season the sacrifice with sweets and butter.

verses.sa: स्तोकानामिन्दुं प्रति शूर इन्द्रो वृषायमाणो वृषभस्तुराषाट्। घृतप्रुषा मनसा मोदमानाः स्वाहा देवा अमृता मादयन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: stokānāminduṃ prati śūra indro vṛṣāyamāṇo vṛṣabhasturāṣāṭ ghṛtapruṣā manasā modamānāḥ svāhā devā amṛtā mādayantām
verses.en: Indra the Bull, swift conqueror, wildly rushing bull-like to meet the Indu of the droppings—Delighting in a mind that scatters fatness, let the Gods rejoice in Svab.!.

verses.sa: आ यात्विन्द्रोऽवस उप न इह स्तुतः सधमदस्तु शूरः। वावृधानस्तविषीर्यस्य पूर्वीर्द्यौर्न क्षत्रमभिभूति पुष्यात्॥
verses.tr: ā yātvindro'vasa upa na iha stutaḥ sadhamadastu śūraḥ vāvṛdhānastaviṣīryasya pūrvīrdyaurna kṣatramabhibhūti puṣyāt
verses.en: May Indra come to us for our protection, here, lauded Hero, he our feast-companion. May he whose powers are m^any, waxen mighty,, cherish, like Dyaus, the sovran sway of princes.

verses.sa: आ न इन्द्रो दूरादा न आसादभिष्टिकृदवसे यासदुग्रः। ओजिष्ठेभिर्नृपतिर्वज्रबाहुः सङ्गे समत्सु तुर्वणिः पृतन्यून्॥
verses.tr: ā na indro dūrādā na āsādabhiṣṭikṛdavase yāsadugraḥ ojiṣṭhebhirnṛpatirvajrabāhuḥ saṅge samatsu turvaṇiḥ pṛtanyūn
verses.en: From near or far away may mighty Indra, giver of succour, come for our protection. Lord of men, armed with thunder, with the Strongest, slaying his foes in conflict, in the battles.

verses.sa: आ न इन्द्रो हरिभिर्यात्वच्छार्वाचीनोऽवसे राधसे च। तिष्ठाति वज्री मघवा विरप्शीमं यज्ञमनु नो वाजसातौ॥
verses.tr: ā na indro haribhiryātvacchārvācīno'vase rādhase ca tiṣṭhāti vajrī maghavā virapśīmaṃ yajñamanu no vājasātau
verses.en: May Indra come to us with Tawny Coursers, inclined to us, to favour and enrich us. May Maghavan, loud-voiced and wielding thunder, stand by us at this sacrifice, in combat.

verses.sa: त्रातारमिन्द्रमवितारमिन्द्रं हवे-हवे सुहवं शूरमिन्द्रम्। ह्वयामि शक्रं पुरुहूतमिन्द्रं स्वस्ति नो मघवा धात्विन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: trātāramindramavitāramindraṃ have-have suhavaṃ śūramindram hvayāmi śakraṃ puruhūtamindraṃ svasti no maghavā dhātvindraḥ
verses.en: Indra the Rescuer, Indra the Helper, Hero who listens at each invocation, $Sakra I call, Indra invoked of many. May Indra, Bounteous ous Lord, prosper and bless us.

verses.sa: इन्द्रः सुत्रामा स्ववाँ२ अवोभिः सुमृडीको भवतु विश्ववेदाः। बाधतां द्वेषो अभयं कृणोतु सुवीर्यस्य पतयः स्याम॥
verses.tr: indraḥ sutrāmā svavāṃ2 avobhiḥ sumṛḍīko bhavatu viśvavedāḥ bādhatāṃ dveṣo abhayaṃ kṛṇotu suvīryasya patayaḥ syāma
verses.en: May helpful Indra as our Good Protector, Lord of all treasures, favour us with succour, Baffle our foes and give us rest and safety, and may we be the lords of hero vigour.

verses.sa: तस्य वयं सुमतौ यज्ञियस्यापि भद्रे सौमनसे स्याम। स सुत्रामा स्ववाँ२ इन्द्रो अस्मे आराच्चिद् द्वेषः सनुतर्युयोतु॥
verses.tr: tasya vayaṃ sumatau yajñiyasyāpi bhadre saumanase syāma sa sutrāmā svavāṃ2 indro asme ārāccid dveṣaḥ sanutaryuyotu
verses.en: May we enjoy the grace of him the Holy, yea, may we dwell in his auspicious favour. May helpful Indra as our Good Preserver drive from us even from afar, our foemen.

verses.sa: आ मन्द्रैरिन्द्र हरिभिर्याहि मयूररोमभिः। मा त्वा के चिन्नि यमन् विं ना पाशिनोऽति धन्वेव ताँ२ इहि॥
verses.tr: ā mandrairindra haribhiryāhi mayūraromabhiḥ mā tvā ke cinni yaman viṃ nā pāśino'ti dhanveva tāṃ2 ihi
verses.en: Come hither, Indra, with Bay Steeds, joyous, with tails like peacock plumes. Let no men check thy course as fowlers stay the bird: pass o'er them as o'er desert lands.

verses.sa: एवेदिन्द्रं वृषणं वज्रबाहुं वसिष्ठासो अभ्यर्चन्त्यर्कैः। स न स्तुतो वीरवद्धातु गोमद्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: evedindraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vajrabāhuṃ vasiṣṭhāso abhyarcantyarkaiḥ sa na stuto vīravaddhātu gomadyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: Verily the Vasishthus hymn with praises Indra the mighty One whose arm wields thunder. Praised, may he guard our wealth in men and cattle. Ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sa: समिद्धो अग्निरश्विना तप्तो घर्मो विराट् सुतः। दुहे धेनुः सरस्वती सोमं शुक्रमिहेन्द्रियम्॥
verses.tr: samiddho agniraśvinā tapto gharmo virāṭ sutaḥ duhe dhenuḥ sarasvatī somaṃ śukramihendriyam
verses.en: Fire hath been kindled, A levins Twain! the Gharma warmed, the Radiant pressed, Here the Milch-Cow Sarasvatt hath poured bright Soma, Indra's own,

verses.sa: तनूपा भिषजा सुतेऽश्विनोभा सरस्वती। मध्वा रजांसीन्द्रियमिन्द्राय पथिभिर्वहान्॥
verses.tr: tanūpā bhiṣajā sute'śvinobhā sarasvatī madhvā rajāṃsīndriyamindrāya pathibhirvahān
verses.en: When Soma flows Sarasvati and both the Asvins, Leeches and Body-guards, bear to Indra strength by passage through the realms of air.

verses.sa: इन्द्रायेन्दुं सरस्वती नराशंसेन नग्नहुम्। अधातामश्विना मधु भेषजं भिषजा सुते॥
verses.tr: indrāyenduṃ sarasvatī narāśaṃsena nagnahum adhātāmaśvinā madhu bheṣajaṃ bhiṣajā sute
verses.en: When Soma flowed the Asvins Twain, the Leeches, brought sweet medicine, With Men's Desire SarasvatI for Indra, Soma, Nagnahu.

verses.sa: आजुह्वाना सरस्वतीन्द्रायेन्द्रियाणि वीर्यम्। इडाभिरश्विनाविषं समूर्जं सं रयिं दधुः॥
verses.tr: ājuhvānā sarasvatīndrāyendriyāṇi vīryam iḍābhiraśvināviṣaṃ samūrjaṃ saṃ rayiṃ dadhuḥ
verses.en: Worshipped, Sarasvati bestowed on Indra, senses, manly power. The Asvins, through oblations paid, combined food, energy, and wealth.

verses.sa: अश्विना नमुचेः सुतं सोमं शुक्रं परिस्रुता। सरस्वती तमा ऽभरद्बर्हिषेन्द्राय पातवे॥
verses.tr: aśvinā namuceḥ sutaṃ somaṃ śukraṃ parisrutā sarasvatī tamā 'bharadbarhiṣendrāya pātave
verses.en: The Asvins brought from Namuchi pressed Soma bright with foaming juice. Sarasvati with sacred grass brought that to Indra for his drink.

verses.sa: कवष्यो न व्यचस्वतीरश्विभ्यां न दुरो दिशः। इन्द्रो न रोदसी उभे दुहे कामान्त्सरस्वती॥
verses.tr: kavaṣyo na vyacasvatīraśvibhyāṃ na duro diśaḥ indro na rodasī ubhe duhe kāmāntsarasvatī
verses.en: Saras and Indra with the Asvins Twain milked out desires From heaven and earth, the regions, the resounding and expansive doors.

verses.sa: उषासानक्तमश्विना दिवेन्द्र सायमिन्द्रियैः। सञ्जानाने सुपेशसा समञ्जाते सरस्वत्या॥
verses.tr: uṣāsānaktamaśvinā divendra sāyamindriyaiḥ sañjānāne supeśasā samañjāte sarasvatyā
verses.en: Ye Asvins, Dawn and Night, by day and in the evening, fair of hue,.Accordant, with Sarasvati, deck Indra with surpassing powers.

verses.sa: पातं नो अश्विना दिवा पाहि नक्तं सरस्वति। दैव्या होतारा भिषजा पातमिन्द्रं सचा सुते॥
verses.tr: pātaṃ no aśvinā divā pāhi naktaṃ sarasvati daivyā hotārā bhiṣajā pātamindraṃ sacā sute
verses.en: Guard us, O Asvins, through the day, guards us by night, Sarasvati. Celestial Hotar, Leeches! both guard Indra when the juice is pressed.

verses.sa: तिस्रस्त्रेधा सरस्वत्यश्विना भारतीडा। तीव्रं परिस्रुता सोममिन्द्राय सुषुवुर्मदम्॥
verses.tr: tisrastredhā sarasvatyaśvinā bhāratīḍā tīvraṃ parisrutā somamindrāya suṣuvurmadam
verses.en: The Asvins, and the Three, apart, Sarasvati, Id, Bhirat?, As drink to gladden Indra, poured strong Soma with the foaming juice.

verses.sa: अश्विना भेषजं मधु भेषजं नः सरस्वती। इन्द्रे त्वष्टा यशः श्रियं रूपं-रूपमधुः सुते॥
verses.tr: aśvinā bheṣajaṃ madhu bheṣajaṃ naḥ sarasvatī indre tvaṣṭā yaśaḥ śriyaṃ rūpaṃ-rūpamadhuḥ sute
verses.en: The Asvins, our Sarasvati, and Tvashtar, when the juice was shed, Gave Indra balm, yea, mead as balm, glory and fame and many a shape.

verses.sa: ऋतुथेन्द्रो वनस्पतिः शशमानः परिस्रुता। कीलालमश्विभ्यां मधु दुहे धेनुः सरस्वती॥
verses.tr: ṛtuthendro vanaspatiḥ śaśamānaḥ parisrutā kīlālamaśvibhyāṃ madhu duhe dhenuḥ sarasvatī
verses.en: Praising with foaming liquor at due times, Indra, Vanaspati, Sarasvati as cow gave forth sweet beverage with the Asvins Twain.

verses.sa: गोभिर्न सोममश्विना मासरेण परिस्रुता। समधातं सरस्वत्या स्वाहेन्द्रे सुतं मधु॥
verses.tr: gobhirna somamaśvinā māsareṇa parisrutā samadhātaṃ sarasvatyā svāhendre sutaṃ madhu
verses.en: A$vms. to Indra ye with cows, with Masara and foaming drink Gave, with Sarasvati—All hail!—the pressed-out Soma juice and mead.

verses.sa: अश्विना हविरिन्द्रियं नमुचेर्धिया सरस्वती। आ शुक्रमासुराद्वसु मघमिन्द्राय जभ्रिरे॥
verses.tr: aśvinā havirindriyaṃ namucerdhiyā sarasvatī ā śukramāsurādvasu maghamindrāya jabhrire
verses.en: The. Asvins and Sarasvatl by wit (from fiendish Namuchi Brought unto Indra sacred food, strength, brilliant treasure, ample wealth.

verses.sa: यमश्विना सरस्वती हविषेन्द्रमवर्धयन्। स बिभेद वलं मघं नमुचावासुरे सचा॥
verses.tr: yamaśvinā sarasvatī haviṣendramavardhayan sa bibheda valaṃ maghaṃ namucāvāsure sacā
verses.en: That Indra, strong through sacrifice by Asvins and Sarasvat, Cleft Vala through to win him wealth, with Namuchi of Asura birth.

verses.sa: तमिन्द्रं पशवः सचाश्विनोभा सरस्वती। दधाना अभ्यनूषत हविषा यज्ञ इन्द्रियैः॥
verses.tr: tamindraṃ paśavaḥ sacāśvinobhā sarasvatī dadhānā abhyanūṣata haviṣā yajña indriyaiḥ
verses.en: Supporting him in sacrifice with sacred" food and mighty powers, Sarasvati, both Asvins and the cattle hymned that Indra's praise.

verses.sa: य इन्द्र इन्द्रियं दधुः सविता वरुणो भगः। स सुत्रामा हविष्पतिर्यजमानाय सश्चत॥
verses.tr: ya indra indriyaṃ dadhuḥ savitā varuṇo bhagaḥ sa sutrāmā haviṣpatiryajamānāya saścata
verses.en: Indra whom Bhaga, Savitar, and Varuna supplied with power, Lord of the sacrifice, may he, Good Guardian, love the worshipper.

verses.sa: सविता वरुणो दधद्यजमानाय दाशुषे। आदत्त नमुचेर्वसु सुत्रामा बलमिन्द्रियम्॥
verses.tr: savitā varuṇo dadhadyajamānāya dāśuṣe ādatta namucervasu sutrāmā balamindriyam
verses.en: Savitar, Varuna bestow gifts on the liberal offerer, Strength, power and treasure which the Good Protector took from Namuchi!

verses.sa: वरुणः क्षत्रमिन्द्रियं भगेन सविता श्रियम्। सुत्रामा यशसा बलं दधाना यज्ञमाशत॥
verses.tr: varuṇaḥ kṣatramindriyaṃ bhagena savitā śriyam sutrāmā yaśasā balaṃ dadhānā yajñamāśata
verses.en: Varuna giving sway and power, Savitar grace with happiness, The Good Protector giving strength with fame, obtained the sacrifice.

verses.sa: अश्विना गोभिरिन्द्रियमश्वेभिर्वीर्यं बलम्। हविषेन्द्रं सरस्वती यजमानमवर्धयन्॥
verses.tr: aśvinā gobhirindriyamaśvebhirvīryaṃ balam haviṣendraṃ sarasvatī yajamānamavardhayan
verses.en: With cows the Asvins, mighty power, with horses manly vigour, strength, With sacred food Sarasvati, made Indra, Sacrificer, strong.

verses.sa: ता नासत्या सुपेशसा हिरण्यवर्तनी नरा। सरस्वती हविष्मतीन्द्र कर्मसु नोऽवत॥
verses.tr: tā nāsatyā supeśasā hiraṇyavartanī narā sarasvatī haviṣmatīndra karmasu no'vata
verses.en: May those Ndsatyas, fair of form, the Men who ride on paths of gold, Oblation-rich Sarasvati, thou, Indra! I help us in our rites.

verses.sa: ता भिषजा सुकर्मणा सा सुदुघा सरस्वती। स वृत्रहा शतक्रतुरिन्द्राय दधुरिन्द्रियम्॥
verses.tr: tā bhiṣajā sukarmaṇā sā sudughā sarasvatī sa vṛtrahā śatakraturindrāya dadhurindriyam
verses.en: Those Leeches righteous in their deeds, She, rich in milk, Sarasvati, That Vritra-slayer hundred-powered, invested Indra with his might.

verses.sa: युवं सुराममश्विना नमुचावासुरे सचा। विपिपानाः सरस्वतीन्द्रं कर्मस्वावत॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ surāmamaśvinā namucāvāsure sacā vipipānāḥ sarasvatīndraṃ karmasvāvata
verses.en: Ye Asvins and Sarasvati, joint drinkers of the Sudi draught. In Namuchi of Asura birth, give-; aid to Indra in his deeds.

verses.sa: पुत्रमिव पितरावश्विनोभेन्द्रावथुः काव्यैर्दंसनाभिः। यत्सुरामं व्यपिबः शचीभिः सरस्वती त्वा मघवन्नभिष्णक्॥
verses.tr: putramiva pitarāvaśvinobhendrāvathuḥ kāvyairdaṃsanābhiḥ yatsurāmaṃ vyapibaḥ śacībhiḥ sarasvatī tvā maghavannabhiṣṇak
verses.en: As parents aid a son, etc., as in X.

verses.sa: यस्मिन्नश्वास ऋषभास उक्षणो वशा मेषा अवसृष्टास आहुताः। कीलालपे सोमपृष्ठाय वेधसे हृदा मतिं जनय चारुमग्नये॥
verses.tr: yasminnaśvāsa ṛṣabhāsa ukṣaṇo vaśā meṣā avasṛṣṭāsa āhutāḥ kīlālape somapṛṣṭhāya vedhase hṛdā matiṃ janaya cārumagnaye
verses.en: He in whom horses, bulls, oxen, and barren cows, and ram, when duly set apart, are offered up,—To Agni, Soma-sprinkled, drinker of sweet juice. Disposer, with thy heart bring forth a pleasant hymn.

verses.sa: अहाव्यग्ने हविरास्ये ते स्रुचीव घृतं चम्वीव सोमः। वाजसनिं रयिमस्मे सुवीरं प्रशस्तं धेहि यशसं बृहन्तम्॥
verses.tr: ahāvyagne havirāsye te srucīva ghṛtaṃ camvīva somaḥ vājasaniṃ rayimasme suvīraṃ praśastaṃ dhehi yaśasaṃ bṛhantam
verses.en: Within thy mouth is poured the offering, Agni, as Soma into cup, 'oil into ladle. Vouchsafe us wealth, strength-winning, blest with heroes, wealth lofty, praised by men, and full of splendour.

verses.sa: अश्विना तेजसा चक्षुः प्राणेन सरस्वती वीर्यम्। वाचेन्द्रो बलेनेन्द्राय दधुरिन्द्रियम्॥
verses.tr: aśvinā tejasā cakṣuḥ prāṇena sarasvatī vīryam vācendro balenendrāya dadhurindriyam
verses.en: The Asvins gaye, with lustre, sight, Sarasvati manly strength with breath. Indra with voice and might gave Indra vigorous power.

verses.sa: गोमदू षु णासत्याश्वावद्यातमश्विना। वर्ती रुद्रा नृपाय्यम्॥
verses.tr: gomadū ṣu ṇāsatyāśvāvadyātamaśvinā vartī rudrā nṛpāyyam
verses.en: With kine, Nasatyas! and with steeds, come, Asvins, Rudras! to the house, the sure protector of its men;

verses.sa: न यत्परो नान्तर आदधर्षद्वृषण्वसू। दुःशंसो मर्त्यो रिपुः॥
verses.tr: na yatparo nāntara ādadharṣadvṛṣaṇvasū duḥśaṃso martyo ripuḥ
verses.en: Such, wealthy Gods! as none afar or standing near to us may harm, yea, no malicious mortal foe.

verses.sa: ता न आ वोढमश्विना रयिं पिशङ्गसंदृशम्। धिष्ण्या वरिवोविदम्॥
verses.tr: tā na ā voḍhamaśvinā rayiṃ piśaṅgasaṃdṛśam dhiṣṇyā varivovidam
verses.en: Do ye, O longed-for Asvins, lead us on to wealth of varied form, wealth that shall bring us room and, rest.

verses.sa: पावका नः सरस्वती वाजेभिर्वाजिनीवती। यज्ञं वष्टु धियावसुः॥
verses.tr: pāvakā naḥ sarasvatī vājebhirvājinīvatī yajñaṃ vaṣṭu dhiyāvasuḥ
verses.en: Wealthy in spoil, enriched with hymns, may pure Sarasvati desire with eager love our sacrifice.

verses.sa: चोदयित्री सूनृतानां चेतन्ती सुमतीनाम्। यज्ञं दधे सरस्वती॥
verses.tr: codayitrī sūnṛtānāṃ cetantī sumatīnām yajñaṃ dadhe sarasvatī
verses.en: She who awakens sounds of joy, inspires our hymns, Sarasvati, she hath allowed our sacrifice.

verses.sa: महो अर्णः सरस्वती प्र चेतयति केतुना। धियो विश्वा वि राजति॥
verses.tr: maho arṇaḥ sarasvatī pra cetayati ketunā dhiyo viśvā vi rājati
verses.en: Sarasvati', the mighty flood, she with her light illuminates, she brightens every pious thought.

verses.sa: इन्द्रा याहि चित्रभानो सुता इमे त्वायवः। अण्वीभिस्तना पूतासः॥
verses.tr: indrā yāhi citrabhāno sutā ime tvāyavaḥ aṇvībhistanā pūtāsaḥ
verses.en: O Indra, marvellously bright, come, these libations long for thee, thus by fine fingers purified.

verses.sa: इन्द्रा याहि धियेषितो विप्रजूतः सुतावतः। उप ब्रह्माणि वाघतः॥
verses.tr: indrā yāhi dhiyeṣito viprajūtaḥ sutāvataḥ upa brahmāṇi vāghataḥ
verses.en: Urged by the holy singer, sped by song, come, Indra, to the prayers of the libation-pouring priest.

verses.sa: इन्द्रा याहि तूतुजान उप ब्रह्माणि हरिवः। सुते दधिष्व नश्चनः॥
verses.tr: indrā yāhi tūtujāna upa brahmāṇi harivaḥ sute dadhiṣva naścanaḥ
verses.en: Approach, O Indra, hasting thee, Lord of Bay Horses, to the prayer: in our libations take delight.

verses.sa: अश्विना पिबतां मधु सरस्वत्या सजोषसा। इन्द्रः सुत्रामा वृत्रहा जुषन्तां सोम्यं मधु॥
verses.tr: aśvinā pibatāṃ madhu sarasvatyā sajoṣasā indraḥ sutrāmā vṛtrahā juṣantāṃ somyaṃ madhu
verses.en: Accordant with Sarasvati let the two Asvins drink the meath. May Indra, Vritra-slayer, Good Guardian, accept the Soma meath.
